sources.level: Weinstein; Bulkowski; IBD (pivot = last resistance before the breakout)
sources.time: Murphy: the longer price traded at a level, the stronger it is
sources.touches: StockCharts / Investopedia: more separate tests = more significant (Bulkowski: not proven)
sources.volume: Murphy; Edwards & Magee: volume at the level is the first criterion (Bulkowski disagrees)
sources.breakout: Weinstein: breakout volume >= 2x average; Murphy: close >= 1% beyond the level
sources.retest: IBD: the 1st and 2nd pullbacks to the pivot are the best, 3rd+ weaker
sources.recency: Murphy: recent trading at the level = stronger (Bulkowski: age does not matter)
sources.round: Murphy; Bulkowski: round numbers stop moves
sources.gap: Murphy: a breakaway gap acts as support on the pullback
sources.trade_entry: Bulkowski (Throwback entry): buy after a close back above the top of the pattern; 89% wins, 10% stopped
sources.trade_sl: AlphaMethodX / Wyckoff: under the retest low and the level; Murphy: beyond a round number; at least 1 weekly ATR under the entry (Bulkowski: tight stops get hit, < 4% ~half the time; normalized by volatility); IBD: max ~7-8%
sources.trade_tp: IBD: the high before the pullback (next resistance); measured move = base height added to the breakout (secondary)
sources.below: Murphy: a close beyond the level weakens it (2 closes / 3% = broken); Weinstein: weekly close
